security.summary:
security lens over LEAN-WORKFLOW (90 product path(s), 6ae2dea..87c5218, Codex via the autoreview skill): 7 blocking, 3 non-blocking. Approval events are not obligatorily digest-bound, task approval can bypass current grill/native-event authority, and Windows context traversal does not reject all reparse points.

Migration path traversal can escape through a symlinked ancestor, while the cold-grill evidence check is too weak to establish the intended approval authority.

The context-file launch test reopens a path instead of preserving the validated handle, leaving the required stable-identity boundary incomplete.

The narrowed-scope validator can convert exact-file authority into directory authority, and task approval can be forged without a consumed native-event tombstone. Both defects cross explicit authorization boundaries and must be fixed before shipping.

The narrowed-scope access-control path and Windows secure-context lifecycle are not tested end to end as their required test names claim, leaving security-sensitive regressions able to pass the suite. No credential exposure is shown.
